description: Pins the cluster_id and acl rejections, the confirm gate, the confirmed PUT with a fully-populated acl body, and the dry-run preview. cluster_id is an integer path param, and proto3 collapses an absent one onto zero, so absent, zero, and negative all answer the positive-integer sentence. The confirm gate is asked before the arguments are read, so the rejection cases carry confirm=true to reach the check they pin. A response that is not a JSON object must fail rather than yield a zeroed ACL.

cases.name: requires cluster_id
cases.expect_error: cluster_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a negative cluster_id
cases.expect_error: cluster_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: requires acl
cases.expect_error: acl is required and must be an object

cases.name: rejects an empty acl
cases.expect_error: acl is required and must be an object

cases.name: answers the confirm gate before the missing acl
cases.expect_error: This modifies the control plane ACL, which controls API server access. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This modifies the control plane ACL, which controls API server access. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: The control-plane ACL is enabled; only the listed addresses may reach the Kubernetes API.
